snippet.title: LEGION OF HONOR – Official Teaser | Wishlist on Steam!
snippet.description:
LEGION OF HONOR is on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4621600/LEGION_OF_HONOR/

LEGION OF HONOR is a PS1-inspired World War II shooter where you fight as resistance operatives behind enemy lines across occupied Europe.

Sabotage the Axis war machine from the inside, and take part in story-driven missions from multiple perspectives.

Inspired by classic titles, LEGION OF HONOR blends gameplay elements from the late 90s/early 2000s with modern quality of life improvements!

Follow development:
Twitter: https://x.com/oopsallsolace

Discord: https://discord.gg/UegeQ4VmPW

#LegionofHonorGame #indiedev #gamedev #ww2 #retrogaming #psx
